name: thin-undeclared-codex-marker
title: Undeclared codex usage from a pack-shipped doc blocks every conversion
description: The pack ships .claude/sd-ai-command-pack/planning-adversarial-review.md, which invokes the codex CLI. No consumer declares codex, so the thin resweep reports undeclared codex usage as a packDefect in all eight consumers and no conversion reaches a clear verdict. RESOLVED 2026-08-11 (option 5, design.md D1): split the document -- the 80-line host contract keeps shipping to every consumer as platform claude, and the 49-line Codex lane moves to templates/.codex/sd-ai-command-pack/planning-adversarial-review-codex.md under platform codex, so it reaches only repositories that declare the platform or pass --all/--platform codex. The four originally enumerated options are all rejections. The operator accepted the resulting capability loss on 2026-08-11: consumers whose developers have the Codex CLI on PATH do lose the lane, because it is gated by runtime probes rather than by the fleet registry.
creator: sdelmas
